task_description: Populate the city sidewalks with ten kinds of static street furniture (street lamps, benches, trash bins, bus shelters, mailboxes, newspaper stands, vending machines, electrical boxes, fire hydrants, advertising boards), non-blocking by default with the switch STREET_FURNITURE_COLLISION in src/core/world.js. Also turn the existing traffic light signal heads to face down toward the road, changing nothing else about the lights.
